resources.string: Puts the camera on your wallpaper: whatever is in front of the phone shows up behind the icons. The camera only turns on when you press the button.
The wallpaper is not set yet.
Camera on: the wallpaper is running behind the icons.

While the camera is on, the privacy dot stays lit and the stock camera app or the flashlight may stop working: only one app can own the camera. It also drains battery, so it is meant for short sessions. Turning it off leaves a black wallpaper; Android does not let an app restore the previous one.
Tap to open the app and turn it off.
The wallpaper cannot work without camera permission.
This device has no compatible wallpaper picker.
